 A low may form near the Bahamas this weekend 
 West Palm Beach, Fla. (WPEC) — The National Hurricane Center is monitoring an area of low pressure expected to develop near the northern Bahamas this weekend.
 This system will continue to move away from Florida if it does form. (WPEC) 
 The system could move north or northeast near or offshore of the southeastern U.S. coast, where it has a low chance of becoming a subtropical system.
 The next name for a storm system to claim is Kyle.
 The next name to claim is Kyle. (WPEC) 
 Development chances remain low 
 The NHC puts the chance of development near 0% through the next 48 hours and at 50% over the next seven days.
 Tropical Satellite.(WPEC) 
 This is a potential area of development, not a tropical or subtropical storm, and no cyclone advisories have been initiated.
 The system is still several days from forming, and its eventual track and strength remain uncertain. 
 We’ll continue to watch for updates as it develops; residents along the southeastern coast should follow local forecasts for any changes.
